title.value: Simons Postdoctoral Fellowships in Plant Biology
title.evidence_quote: Simons Postdoctoral Fellowships in Plant Biology

qualifications: PhD earned no earlier than three years before the deadline, or expected by the start date
U.S. citizens and foreign applicants may apply
Award issued only to U.S. nonprofit research universities or research institutions
Two tracks: plant biologists training with mentors in other fields, or researchers from other fields applying their expertise to plant biology
description_short: Three-year postdoctoral fellowships for plant biologists moving into other fields, or researchers from other fields moving into plant biology, hosted at U.S. nonprofit research institutions. Applications through Simons Award Manager by 3 December 2026, noon ET; start between July and October 2027.
